# Scenario: with allow-ports-mapping, host IPs 0.0.0.0 and :: are rejected;
# the cycle soft-fails and prior containers stay running.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: baseline without wildcard ports'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: healthy stack ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.ipv4-wildcard.yml dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml
cp ../settings.allow-ports.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: publish 0.0.0.0 host IP'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: 0.0.0.0 rejected; prior container untouched ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'disallowed host IP'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.ipv6-wildcard.yml dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: publish :: host IP'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 3: :: rejected; prior container still untouched ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'disallowed host IP'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.allow-ports.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
      allow-ports-mapping: true

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"

-- compose.ipv4-wildcard.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    ports:
      - "0.0.0.0:18080:80"

-- compose.ipv6-wildcard.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    ports:
      - "[::]:18080:80"

-- .env --
